reviews.content: It's a fun story as long as you don't think too hard about the specifics. The main character can be a little frustrating, but his bond with his father and the other S-ranks is sweet. The big reveal at the end was also interesting and not at all sudden, but I do wish there was more on it. Still, it was a pretty fun read.
